description.en: The model step of lane_pilot_route when System One cannot decide a request alone: a read-only helper thread sees the owner's request and the cards of the top candidate workflows and chooses among them, with the pattern, the rejected options, a confidence and up to three questions. Started by lane_pilot_route; the router discards an answer outside the candidates.
description.ru: Модельный шаг lane_pilot_route, когда System One не может решить запрос сам: читающий помощник видит запрос владельца и карточки лучших кандидатов и выбирает среди них, с образцом, отклонёнными вариантами, уверенностью и не более чем тремя вопросами. Запускается lane_pilot_route; ответ вне кандидатов маршрутизатор отбрасывает.

not_for: anything a person asks in a chat: lane_pilot_route starts this itself

candidates.note: the cards of the top candidate workflows

proof.reason: a choice among the candidates; the router checks it against them and falls back to its scorer
proof.form: JSON: choice, confidence, pattern, rejected, questions, handoff

input.intent: Review and fix the login code

test.live: lane_pilot_route asks it when System One does not decide; read the run of lp.route
